title: Instinct was the buzziest AI agent around — can it survive Muse?
script:
Instinct is worth ten billion dollars with no app. It's an AI agent you text.
It launched in August with no marketing. Then Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots arrived.
You chat over iMessage, WhatsApp, or email. It plugs into your calendar.
Reviewer Allison Johnson had it email her eye doctor and start an Ikea return.
It identified a Tjusig from her vague description: vertical, white, with branches.
But it missed a prerequisite class for her son's swim lessons.
Instinct has no monthly fee, for now. OpenAI's Dots is paid-only.
Analyst Avi Greengart: not paying directly means paying indirectly. Would you trust it?
